description: Election Commission - Declare that M. H. C. K. Fernando was Selected as the member of the Nivitigala Pradeshiya Sabha and I. A. M. Ilankoon was elected as the member of the Balangoda Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government bodies (Nivitigala Pradeshiya Sabha and Balangoda Urban Council) due to members ceasing to hold office or being elected to Parliament. The notices are issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involve the formal declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies. This directly relates to electoral processes and local government member appointments, falling under the Elections category (Type 7).
